entities.summary: Astrid Huberta Isolde Marie Luise Hildegard Proll is a German woman who was an early member of the Red Army Faction. She is a photo editor and published a book. Astrid Proll was a painters & sculptors from Kassel (b. 1947-05-29, Kassel). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
